doc.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: Bird, Ben Webster and the 1950s decline
title: The Cottage Grove clubs fade after Bird's death; Clifford Brown's visit
summary: Freeman says Bird's death took the enthusiasm from the music, and recalls Clifford Brown visiting the Pershing before his fatal crash.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: He was there. Then he went off with Max Roach and Clifford Brown, and they came back and played the Bee Hive at one point. All these clubs, like the clubs on Cottage and all that stuff, when did all that stuff start phasing out? What period . . . ?

Bird signed it off. When Bird died, the music lost all its enthusiasm. See, first Clifford Brown died in this automobile accident thing, he and Bud Powell’s brother. They came by my set, which is so weird.
See, he died in – what was it? – ’53? It’s something like that. Because Bird died . . .
Because I’m almost sure Clifford Brown died in ’56 and Bird died in ’55.
But it’s around the same period of time.
That was a big – the cats thought that was a big loss too, though.

Oh yeah. Clifford came by and played. I had Billy Wallace with me, and he loved Clifford, just idolized him. I had him playing the piano. He invited Clifford by. Clifford came by and just knocked everybody out. He shot pool a lot too. He was a great pool player. They had a pool room back past the liquor store there.
Because he didn’t drink or nothing, right? He was real clean.

No, and I don’t think Richie Powell drank either, because they were like kind of soul mates. We all hugged them and told them so long, and that’s when they were on the highway and got killed. So I remember that very distinctly. I might have the dates mixed up, but I thought that Clifford – I thought he died before Bird, I thought.
I’m pretty sure he died after Bird, because I’ve got some records that he made, and Bird was already – not that long after, though, like just around in the same period.
